title: EMERGENCYBIAS: BIAS IN TEXT-TO-IMAGE MODELS UNDER EMERGENCY SCENARIOS

bias_targets.methodology: Annotating the gender (male, female) of characters in generated emergency scene images using multimodal LLMs, then computing Demographic Bias Score (DBS) for representation disparities, and Help Bias Score (HBS) and Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) for behavioral and action-level disparities.

Annotating the age (young, middle-aged, older) of characters in generated emergency scene images using multimodal LLMs, and measuring representational skew via Demographic Bias Score (DBS) and behavioral disparities via Help Bias Score (HBS) and Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD).

Annotating the skin tone (light, medium, dark) of characters in generated emergency scene images using multimodal LLMs, and evaluating representation and action-level biases using Demographic Bias Score (DBS), Help Bias Score (HBS), and Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD).
